verdict.rationale: The evidence shows two things, neither of which lets an ops user set controls. Stripe runs its own automatic risk controls 'without requiring action to enable'. The fraud guide tells platforms to 'build and operate' their own controls for money movement and feature changes, which is a developer building block rather than a product capability. Nothing documents configurable per-account or per-program transaction or velocity limits, holds on suspicious activity, or account freezes with reinstatement paths.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can set risk controls per account and per program — transaction and velocity limits, holds on suspicious activity, and account freezes with documented reinstatement paths
